articles.title: Where Niagara Residents Can Set Off Fireworks for Diwali, City by City
articles.excerpt: Niagara Falls permits Diwali fireworks November 7-11 and St. Catharines November 7-9, each with strict hours and private-property rules. Welland's bylaw does not list Diwali, and Thorold requires the Fire Chief's written approval for other holidays.
articles.nri_angle: Ontario's Niagara region has a growing South Asian community, and its Diwali fireworks rules differ sharply by municipality — Niagara Falls and St. Catharines permit them on set dates, while Welland and Thorold do not permit a Diwali display as of right.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Ekta Nagar's Glow Garden and 1.5-Crore-Light Display Draw Diwali-Week Families
articles.excerpt: An upgraded Unity Glow Garden, a 530-metre illuminated stretch and a 180-metre Glow Tunnel anchor Ekta Prakash Parv at the Statue of Unity, while Bharat Parv runs until November 15 and the statue stays open on Monday, November 9.
articles.nri_angle: Ekta Nagar's upgraded glow garden and light festival give diaspora families visiting Gujarat for Diwali a concrete after-dark itinerary at the Statue of Unity, including a special Monday opening on November 9.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Air India Courts UK Travel Trade in London During World Travel Market
articles.excerpt: The airline hosted diaspora-heavy UK travel sellers with Tourism Minister Shekhawat, building on its new tourism-promotion MoU with the ministry.
articles.image_caption: The London skyline. Air India hosted UK travel trade leaders in the capital on the sidelines of World Travel Market London.
articles.nri_angle: Much of the UK-India travel trade in the room is diaspora-run, and the push targets the VFR and heritage travel diaspora families book every year.

articles.title: Edmonton Warns Diwali Fireworks Without Permit Are Illegal, Fines Reach $10,000
articles.excerpt: Only certified professionals with a city permit may launch fireworks in Edmonton. For Diwali, a free permitted display runs at Mill Woods Park on Sunday, November 8, with fireworks at 8:30 p.m.
articles.image_caption: Fireworks burst over the night sky during a public display. Edmonton allows only certified professionals with a city permit to launch fireworks, with fines of up to $10,000 for unpermitted use.

articles.nri_angle: Edmonton's South Asian families get a clear Diwali plan: no home fireworks without a professional permit, and a free city-backed display at Mill Woods Park on November 8 instead.

articles.title: Air India Suspends Delhi-Birmingham Nonstop Flights for Winter Season
articles.excerpt: The three-times-weekly Delhi-Birmingham service is withdrawn from November 4, 2026 for winter 2026-27. Amritsar-Birmingham and four-daily Delhi-Heathrow remain the main Air India alternatives, and ticket holders should check rebooking and refund options now.

articles.nri_angle: For the West Midlands' large South Asian community, the loss of the Delhi nonstop means re-routing via Amritsar, Heathrow or a hub this winter, starting with checking any November 4-onward booking.

articles.title: Six Affordable International Trips for the Diwali Long Weekend
articles.excerpt: From Kathmandu from Rs 8,596 to Hanoi, Colombo, Bangkok, Tashkent and Baku, two Diwali guides map six short-haul breaks that fit the Nov. 6-11 festival window — with 'from' fares and full-trip budgets as the sources state them.

articles.title: Air India Wants More Wide-Body Jets, Eyes Profitability Very Soon
articles.excerpt: New CEO Tewolde Gebremariam says the existing order book is not enough for the airline's network ambitions, as costs, losses and airspace closures squeeze the Tata Group turnaround.
articles.image_caption: Air India chief executive Tewolde Gebremariam speaks at an industry event. Gebremariam said the airline is seeking more wide-body aircraft and expects to reach profitability 'very soon.'
articles.nri_angle: For the diaspora, a larger wide-body fleet and a possible Bengaluru hub would mean more long-haul capacity and better connections between India and the U.S., Europe and the Gulf.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Rare Annapurna Darshan Opens in Kashi for Dhanteras and Diwali 2026
articles.excerpt: The special murti at Varanasi's Annapurna Temple, beside Kashi Vishwanath, is open only around Dhanteras and Annakut — November 6 to 11 in 2026, with Annakut on November 10.
articles.image_caption: The Kashi Vishwanath temple complex in Varanasi, with its gold-plated spire. The adjoining Annapurna temple opens its rare annual darshan to devotees during the Dhanteras and Diwali period.
articles.nri_angle: For diaspora visitors travelling to India for Diwali, the rare Annapurna darshan window is November 6 to 11, 2026, with Dhanteras on November 6 and Annakut on November 10.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Abu Dhabi Pitches Two, Four and Seven-Day Diwali Getaways
articles.excerpt: DCT Abu Dhabi has published Diwali itineraries built around Yas Island, Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, Saadiyat and the desert — a three-to-four-hour flight from major Indian cities, with prices and offers left to its official campaign page.
articles.nri_angle: A three-to-four-hour flight from major Indian cities makes Abu Dhabi a realistic Diwali-week option for India-based families and a stopover add-on for diaspora travellers routing through the Gulf.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: IndiGo Leans on Mumbai and Premium Cabins as Pakistan Airspace Closure Disrupts Westward Flights
articles.excerpt: With Delhi's westward routes squeezed by the closure of Pakistani airspace and jet fuel prices elevated, IndiGo CEO Willie Walsh says the airline will push European growth through Mumbai, keep its Amsterdam slots with the A321XLR, and go premium on the A350 from 2028.
articles.image_caption: The Bandra-Worli Sea Link crosses Mahim Bay in Mumbai. IndiGo said Mumbai offers room to add European destinations while Delhi westward routes face disruption from the closure of Pakistani airspace.
articles.nri_angle: IndiGo's Mumbai-led European push and its planned lie-flat A350 cabins from 2028 mean more nonstop India-Europe options for diaspora travellers who currently connect through Gulf or European hubs.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Karnataka Takes Tourism Roadshows to Manchester, London and Birmingham
articles.excerpt: Led by Tourism Minister Kelachandra Joseph George, the UK programme pairs WTM London with diaspora-city roadshows as the state works to revive declining NRI footfall, The Hindu reported.
articles.image_caption: The London skyline at dusk, with Tower Bridge over the Thames. Karnataka Tourism exhibits at World Travel Market London from November 3 to 5, 2026, between roadshows in Manchester and Birmingham.
articles.nri_angle: The Birmingham and Manchester stops put the pitch in two of Britain's biggest South Asian diaspora cities, aimed at NRIs who combine family visits with touring.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Seven Places to See Diwali at Its Brightest, From Ayodhya's Deepotsav to Amritsar
articles.excerpt: Diwali falls on Sunday, November 8, 2026. Ayodhya, Varanasi, Jaipur, Amritsar, Kolkata, Goa and Udaipur each celebrate differently — here is what each does best and how to choose.
articles.image_caption: The Golden Temple (Sri Harmandir Sahib) in Amritsar, seen across the sarovar. Amritsar marks Diwali alongside Bandi Chhor Divas, when the temple is illuminated for the festival.
articles.nri_angle: For diaspora families timing an India trip to the festival, Diwali on Sunday, November 8 makes a long weekend; book the Ayodhya and Varanasi legs early and keep Dev Deepawali's separate date in mind.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Saudi Carriers Add India Flights as Indian Airlines Extend Suspensions to November 14
articles.excerpt: Flynas is adding services from Dammam to six Indian cities and from Riyadh to three, the Indian Consulate in Jeddah said, while Air India, IndiGo and Akasa keep most Saudi routes suspended.
articles.nri_angle: For the millions of Indians working in Saudi Arabia and Umrah pilgrims, the working options right now are Saudi carriers and one-stop routings; Indian-carrier tickets need rebooking or refunds.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Bengaluru-Mumbai Vande Bharat Sleeper Bookings Open, Fares Start at Rs 2,810

articles.title: Indian Airlines Extend Saudi Suspensions, IndiGo Cancels Till November 14
articles.excerpt: Air India and Air India Express keep Riyadh and Dammam suspended till November 7 and Jeddah till October 31, while IndiGo's Saudi cancellations now run to November 14 — with refunds and one free rebooking for bookings made on or before October 24.
articles.nri_angle: Hundreds of thousands of Indian workers and Umrah travellers use these Saudi routes; the staggered suspension dates and the October 24 booking cutoff decide who gets a free rebooking or a full refund.
